c1_fact: Crawl4AI provides a Python SDK and a secure HTTP API via its Docker API server, which can be easily called from TypeScript using fetch or standard HTTP clients.
c2_fact: It can run headless on a GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner using Playwright, which is natively supported on Linux environments without requiring external infrastructure. Installation requires pip install and Playwright browser setup.
c4_fact: While it is a Python tool utilizing Playwright (requiring ~150MB+ for browser binaries), setup is straightforward and executing a single URL crawl to extract text/Markdown is extremely fast, easily completing well within the 2-3 minute time limit.
